title: Bay State Gas Company files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy an Interruptible Transportation Agreement and Interruptible Gas Supply Service Agreement with the Massachusetts Department of Corrections.
petitioner: Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Judith F. Judson and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 05-GC-23)
